title: What if a zombie outbreak started on Halloween?
premise: On Halloween night, a real zombie outbreak starts in one city. Nobody can tell the costumes from the real thing.

intro.title: What if a *zombie* outbreak started on Halloween?
intro.subtitle: A HYPOTHETICAL SIMULATION

beats.caption: October 31st. The streets are packed with people dressed as monsters.
So when someone really starts biting, nobody reacts. It looks like part of the show.
By the time anyone notices, the crowd itself has become the danger.

banner.title: STAY INDOORS
banner.subtitle: Authorities urge residents to lock their doors

beats.caption: Roads jam as everyone tries to leave at once.
Without workers, the power grid starts to fail.

tooltip.label: REAL STUDY
tooltip.text: Cornell researchers simulated a US zombie outbreak in 2015. The safest places were remote areas like the northern Rockies.

beats.caption: Outbreaks spread fastest where people live closest together.
Survivors head for the empty mountains, far from any crowd.
The cities go quiet. Nature starts taking them back.
